name: Slider
looksLike: line with a knob I drag to change a value
volume control with a handle on a track
drag a dot between minimum and maximum
definition: A control with a movable handle for choosing a value within a range, such as volume or brightness.
whenToUse: Choosing a value within fixed limits

notConfusedWith.difference: Displays completion; it does not let the user adjust a value.

prompts.short: Add a labeled slider with keyboard adjustment and a visible current value.
prompts.detailed: Add a native range input with a visible label, minimum, maximum, and step. Show its current value and units, preserve arrow-key controls and visible focus, and give the input a 44px-high interaction area. Offer a number input when exact entry matters.

html: <input id="volume" name="volume" type="range" min="0" max="100" step="1" value="50" aria-describedby="volume-unit" style="min-height:44px; width:100%; margin:0" oninput="document.getElementById('volume-value').textContent = this.value">

a11yNotes: Label the range and communicate units
Preserve keyboard adjustment and visible focus
Provide precise entry when a slider alone is insufficient
